title: Analyze ICI Delay Wave
description: Deterministic diagnostic action to trace `ici-sdc-test` iteration progression, identify minimum iteration N_min S0 cores with SEND sync flag stalls versus downstream RECV-DONE stalls, and isolate culprit chip coordinates.
instruction: python3 tools/scripts/analyze_ici_wave.py --workload_name="${workload_name}" --project_id="${project_id}" $(if [ -n '${logs_file}' ]; then echo "--logs_file=${logs_file}"; fi) $(if [ -n '${logs}' ]; then echo "--logs=${logs}"; fi)

logs.description: Raw or formatted log entries containing XLA_SDC_CHECKER, ICI transfer wait, or sflag timeout telemetry.

logs_file.description: Optional path to a scratch file containing pulled ICI diagnostic logs (from query-ici-logs).
